<!-- nativecmpkit-progress:d849515b:ci-policy -->

Contained development checkpoint at `d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f` (single-agent).

- Owner policy is reflected in AGENTS.md/ADR0005/executable checks: Actions enabled, all actions allowed, no mandatory SHA pinning; verification tokens remain read-only with checkout credentials disabled. Publishing/Pages remain gated.
- Held-source preflight: 801 Python tooling methods (121 CI methods), strict MkDocs and actionlint pass. These are not native or packaged-consumer tests.
- Previous immutable CI: core831 passes; macOS426 passes including real AppKit cancellation. iPhone332pass/16fail and WebView0 after compile failure; Windows421pass/1fail plus four unexpected filesystem-policy skips. All failures preserved.
- New owned API35 instrumentation is running as [40422019219](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40422019219); no result is claimed yet. Its setup, actual test outcomes, identity/security and teardown are separate gates.

[Checkpoint/evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f/docs/development/checkpoint-ci-20261026.md). Dependency trust, legal/native provenance, ABI and packaged-consumer requirements remain open; no issue closure or release authorization is inferred.

<!-- nativecmpkit-progress:cache-and-android-fa27c39f:BUILD-007 -->
### Contained CI verification progress, dependency gate still unresolved

The owner-authorized all-actions/no-required-SHA-pinning policy remains in place with read-only verification tokens and no persisted checkout credentials. The held-source [21-command preflight](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/fa27c39fc307b51354d98e0a54a7f6e64e60c4fc/docs/development/evidence/ci-preflight-20261027-003/lead-review.json) passed **812 Python tooling methods**, including132 CI methods, plus strict MkDocs and actionlint. These are not library or dependency-trust passes.

The scoped Windows cache run [40429039349](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40429039349) passed77 actual library executions; paired source/ZIP/XML review and limitations are archived.

Android [40425272170](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40425272170) remains a reviewed **zero-test failure** despite passed XML/UTP guards and clean owned-emulator shutdown. Actual JDK17/AGP9.4.0/Gradle9.7.1 method invocation reproduces immutable serial-list mutation at `DeviceProviderInstrumentTestTask.java:547`, including when the setter receives a mutable list. The [owning selector repair and evidence](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/fa27c39fc307b51354d98e0a54a7f6e64e60c4fc/docs/development/android-device-selection.md) use AGP's supported child-only `ANDROID_SERIAL` provider contract, reject inherited conflicts before quarantine and require empty target-option lists. The fixed init script compiled/configured; [new immutable Android verification40430738675](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40430738675) is running, **not a passing result**.

**Keep BUILD-007 open.** Root/convention resolved-graph locking/artifact+metadata verification, actual runtime-witness completeness, advisory/license/provenance review, native/ABI/consumer and complete target gates remain unsatisfied. No packages, releases or deployments were published and no stable-CI/release certification is asserted.

<!-- nativecmpkit-progress:BUILD-007:20261027-cebdc8f2-exact-runtime -->
### Selected real dependency-runtime witness repaired; ordinary trust gate remains unresolved

Three real Gradle9.7.1/JDK17 topology invocations and a known live parent/child control established two owning observer defects: this host lacks`children` files on still-live threads, and the exact directly parented daemon creates its own PID=group=session. The repair retains unknown inventory, nominates only the exact fresh controlled-fixture runtime receipt PID, and still checks live exact parent/start/UID/JDK/cwd/full command/private environment plus pidfd identity. Receipt hashes bind the same parsed bytes; ambiguity/failed attaches are not retried. No global JVM scan or arbitrary receipt-PID attach is allowed.

[Actual007 held-source paired review](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/cebdc8f206a5e34b39e1cb8053b380ba509707c2/docs/development/evidence/build/dependency-fixtures/fixture007-runtime-witness-20261027/lead-independent-review.json) passes **six fresh Gradle invocations (0/0/1/1/1/1)**, all four exact selected lock rejections, **12 real jcmd observations (6clients/6daemons)** and all6 PID/version/source/path/hash bindings. Sources were held as an explicitly dirty diagnostic; their repaired bytes are now committed here, not retroactively called an immutable release run. Core008 and original failed005/006 receipts remain unchanged.148 observer methods pass; these Python methods are not library/consumer tests.

Normal completed scoped PID absence and owned tmpfs cleanup pass. **Forced daemon cleanup on timeout/interruption is NOT proven:** the original controller kills only the client's group while daemons may own another group. A separate owning-controller repair and real bounded cancellation test are required; no arbitrary recorded PID may be signaled.

**Issue stays unresolved/open.** Ordinary root/convention/composite locks/checksum enforcement, complete settings/detached/script/tool graphs, remaining tamper cases, empty-cache/frozen installations, wrapper/compiler/native-cache use and independently reviewed advisory/license/provenance remain. Selected local-Maven/runtime verification is not dependency trust or release readiness. Full details: [checkpoint](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/cebdc8f206a5e34b39e1cb8053b380ba509707c2/docs/development/checkpoint-verification-20261027-continuation.md).
